senses.gloss: f. (מָנָה) appointed, deputy, superintendent, in gen. officer.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 2:11">Tosef. Pes. II</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 3:11">III</cite>), 11 <he>זונין הממ׳</he>; <cite ref="Pesachim 49a:2">Pes. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של ר״ג</he> Zunin the deputy of Rabban G. (superintendent of the College).
<cite ref="Sotah 42a:14">Sot. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>שיש מ׳ על גביו</he> who has a superior in office.
<cite ref="Sotah 42a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>סגן לאו מ׳ הוא</he> the deputy high priest is no active officer.

Snh. II, 1 המ׳ ממצעו וכ׳ the m’munneh places him between himself and the people; ib. 19ᵃ היינו סגן היינו מ׳ the sagan (Tosef. ib. IV, 1) is the same as the m’munneh (in Mish. l. c.), i.e. the deputy high priest.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:4">Shek. V, 4</cite> <he>שהוא מ׳ על וכ׳</he> who was the superintendent of seals &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְמוּנִּים</he>, <he>מְמוּנִּין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:1">Ib. 1</cite> <he>אלו הן המ׳ וכ׳</he> those were the special officers in the Temple; a. e.
